meta.name: li-reply
meta.description: Handle the replies under the user's own LinkedIn posts - draft answers to every comment, sorted by which ones are worth answering. Use when the user pastes the comments on their post, says "reply to these", "handle my comments", "someone said X on my post", or is dealing with a critic or a lead in the comments.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把帖子下的每条评论变成能直接发出的回复草稿，并排好先回哪条
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常发 LinkedIn 帖子，评论一多就不知道先回谁、怎么回
copy.tagline_en: Draft replies to every comment on your posts, ranked by priority.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you post on LinkedIn and get buried in comments you never answer.

howto.what: 把你 LinkedIn 帖子下的评论分成 LEAD、SUBSTANCE、PEER、SUPPORT、NOISE 五档并报出数量,再按价值顺序逐条起草可直接复制的回复,按档分组输出。回复不会自动发布,等你说同意后由你自己粘贴。
howto.when: 当你贴出自己帖子下的评论(文字或截图),或说“回复这些”“处理我的评论”,以及评论里出现质疑者或潜在客户时触发。

say.text: 这是我帖子下的评论,帮我排序并起草回复
say.note: 先分档计数,再按顺序写回复

say.text: 有个同行在评论里反驳我,帮我回
say.note: 先承认对方说对的部分,再守住立场

say.text: 评论里有人问具体做法,怎么回?
say.note: 答案直接写在公开回复里,不推去私信

howto.what_en: Sorts comments on your LinkedIn post into five buckets (LEAD, SUBSTANCE, PEER, SUPPORT, NOISE) and drafts a copy-ready reply for each, grouped and ordered by value. Nothing posts until you say yes; you paste them yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you paste the comments on your own post, say "reply to these" or "handle my comments", or when a critic or a lead shows up in the comments.

say_en.text: Here are the comments on my post - sort them and draft replies
say_en.note: Triages first, then writes in order

say_en.text: A peer pushed back in my comments - draft my reply
say_en.note: Concedes the true part, then holds the line

say_en.text: Someone asked for details in the comments
say_en.note: Answer goes fully in the public reply
